title: S04 — Gap analysis
body:
# S04 — Gap analysis

## Baseline

The v1 registry without the derive crate: declarations and routes could drift, and the served spec
had no lock.

## Target

The S04 gate: derive, manifest, OpenAPI, MCP, invocation and ingest from one declaration, locked.

## Gaps and work packages

Closed by the two accepted deliverables (derive crate; registry and vocabularies) under change
`01a2054b-3f86…`; the remaining work packages are the deliverables' decomposition rows, recorded
as such.
